title: Tested, Trusted, Torn? Emerging Middle Powers Report 2026
description: The third Emerging Middle Powers Report reveals interesting trends. In every recent year, the five countries surveyed – India, Germany, South Africa, Brazil, and Indonesia – have been tested by events to prove they can prevail over the contested terrain of global politics. A pattern has emerged linking them together: non-alignment is their preferred response to a fragmenting order. The post Tested, Trusted, Torn? Emerging Middle Powers Report 2026 appeared first on Gateway House.
